payload.adrs:
ADR-1 LOCATE-BY-SCAN: openInstance spans the .worktrees/* homes (plus trunk); the worktrees are the single source of truth for live iterations. Addresses R3 + DRY. Rejected: K2 trunk-pointer (drift), K3 server-registry (memory not truth); K2 kept as the scale fallback.
ADR-2 PROVISION-BY-DEFAULT: se_loop_start provisions iter/<id> in .worktrees/<id> unless the root is already a worktree; the opt-in flag is removed. Addresses R1 + R2. Reverses note-e8a12b600638. Rejected: a plan flag defaulted true.
ADR-3 LOCAL MACHINE AS A DRAWING: machineFor prefers an iteration-local machine drawing (lifting loadIterationMachine to top-level), seeded from systematic and trimmed; else the named machine. Addresses R4 + R5 (validateMachine integrity). Rejected: strike-list overlay (deferred = req-lean-strike).
ADR-4 PROVEN-LIVE ACCEPTANCE: acceptance is a demonstration test running open->walk->gate->ship inside a worktree through the real tools; unit-green does not satisfy. Addresses R7; closes note-6815f9db4930.
payload.baseline:
Elements (black-box, one line each):
- E1 Provisioner (worktree.ts provisionWorktree, made default in loop.start): in = iteration id; out = iter/<id> tree+branch, unless already a worktree root.
- E2 Locator (loop.ts openInstance, WIDENED): in = server root; out = the open instance wherever it lives (scans .worktrees/* homes + trunk).
- E3 Driver (loop.ts next/submit, logic unchanged, fed by E2): in = located instance; out = work packet / offer / advance.
- E4 MachineResolver (loop.ts machineFor + machines/load.ts, LIFTED): in = instance; out = the iteration-local machine drawing if present, else the named ledger machine.
- E5 Reunifier (worktree.ts shipMerge, unchanged): in = branch; out = trunk merge + suspects.
- E6 LiveProof (the demonstration test harness): in = a real iteration; out = pass iff open->walk->gate->ship completes in the worktree via real tools.
- E7 FramingGuidance (draft_vision/define_actual/frame_delta guidance notes): in = author; out = inherit-se.vision instruction.
payload.allocation_exact: Every function allocated exactly once: Isolate -> E1; Locate -> E2; Drive -> E3; Adapt -> E4; Reunify -> E5; Prove -> E6; Guide -> E7. No function unallocated, none double-allocated.
payload.interfaces_both_ends:
Element DSM, symmetric where it must be:
- E1 <-> E2: E1 creates the tree E2 scans (both know the .worktrees home layout).
- E2 <-> E3: E2 hands the located instance to E3.
- E2/E3 <-> E4: E4 resolves the machine for the instance E2/E3 operate on.
- E1 <-> E5: E5 folds back the branch E1 created.
- E6 spans E1-E5 (exercises them end-to-end, a cross-cutting edge).
- E7 standalone (no runtime edge - the guidance is authoring-time).
Each coupling recorded at both ends.
